article_context: Body image for the «Flight School» section: it illustrates the controlled but extreme wing-ride rotation, supporting the claim that a full inversion is the challenge riders return for.
image_reading: Indoor wing ride with several suspended seats on large rotating arms; a rider in a bright pink jacket is visibly inverted at the right side.
The sweeping metal arms and tilted seats make the ride’s rotation and changing orientation the natural source of motion.
Smiling riders and the dinosaur-themed indoor setting convey thrilling amusement-park excitement.

models.positive_prompt: The ride’s wing arms rotate steadily upward through a controlled arc while the suspended seats tilt with them; the pink-clad rider remains clearly visible as the seat reaches a stable full inversion near the end. Fixed camera.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the visible wing mechanism carries the seats through one steady rotational sweep. Let the seat angles respond naturally to the arm movement while keeping the riders’ bodies restrained in their seats; the right-side pink rider remains the focal confirmation of the maneuver. Keep the camera fixed to preserve the readable geometry. By the last frames, the pink rider’s seat is clearly at a full upside-down orientation, with only slight residual mechanical motion.

models.positive_prompt: A smooth powered sweep of the ride’s wings lifts and rotates the suspended seats, building toward the pink-clad rider holding a clear full inversion at the end. Fixed view on the rotating mechanism.
models.scene_plan: Use the five-second span for a continuous, moderately paced rotation of the ride’s arms rather than a sudden flip. The foreground seats and the inverted pink rider provide the visible progression; other cabins follow the same mechanical motion without competing gestures. Hold a fixed view on the rotating structure. The action resolves late with the pink rider unmistakably upside down at the top of the arc, still conveying controlled exhilaration.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the ride mechanism as its wing arms sweep through a smooth rotation and the suspended seats tilt; end with the pink-clad rider clearly held in a full inversion.
models.scene_plan: For the four-second shot, make the ride’s mechanical sweep a compact, continuous motion. The arms rotate at an even moderate pace and the suspended seats tilt accordingly, with the pink rider on the right retained as the focal point. Keep the camera fixed. Near the end, the ride settles into the readable endpoint of that rider’s seat at a complete inversion, without changing the exhilarated tone.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation emphasizes the attraction’s sought-after challenge: riders deliberately push a controllable flight ride toward a full inversion.
structured_intent.primary_action: The ride’s wing arms continuously rotate, carrying the suspended seats through the inversion arc.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The ride remains a controlled extreme attraction, and the riders’ exhilarated sense of daring persists through the final frame.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The pink-clad rider’s suspended seat is visibly in a clear full upside-down position.
